text: What was the 1990 Mass Uprising? It was a broad anti-autocracy movement that united parties, students, and citizens and forced regime change.
Why did the 1990 movement succeed? Sustained street pressure, opposition coordination, and legitimacy collapse of authoritarian rule converged.
What changed after the uprising? It opened the way for a return to competitive parliamentary politics and electoral transfer mechanisms.
Why does 1990 remain a democratic reference point? It symbolizes cross-ideological public mobilization for accountable civilian governance.
1990 proved that a coordinated civic front could compel authoritarian retreat.
